questions.answer:
A key assumption made in the direct collocation method for optimal control is the piecewise polynomial representation of the state and control trajectories over the time horizon. This method involves discretizing the control problem by approximating the state and control variables as continuous functions that are represented by polynomial segments, typically of low degree, over subdivided intervals of the time domain.

questions.answer:

\dot{x} = f(x, u, t)
